chronology.prehistory_rule: Coverage begins twenty XNYS sessions before the 2020-07-27 feature chronology so every prior-20-session same-clock relative-volume input is covered. No conclusion extends beyond the frozen dates.

normalization.basis: The basis is the share unit in use on the session whose relative-volume feature is being computed.
normalization.effective_boundary: For an action effective before the market open, every bar on the effective session is already in post-action units. The preceding XNYS session remains in pre-action units.
normalization.prior_volume_rule: Multiply each prior-session same-clock share count by every exact new_shares/old_shares ratio whose effective session is after the source session and on or before the basis session.
normalization.same_session_price_rule: Retain raw contemporaneous prices for fills, marks, and same-session calculations. Do not create a provider-adjusted or repository-adjusted historical price view.
normalization.same_session_return_proof: Within one session the split factor f is constant, so (f*p1)/(f*p0)-1 equals p1/p0-1.
normalization.raw_dollar_volume_proof: For split ratio r, post-unit price times post-unit volume is (p/r)*(v*r)=p*v, so raw contemporaneous dollar volume is unit invariant.
normalization.reverse_split_rule: Use the same new_shares/old_shares orientation. A 1-for-5 reverse split maps a pre-action share count to the post-action basis by multiplying by 1/5.
normalization.multiple_action_rule: Multiply exact ratios in effective-session order. Crossing the same actions in reverse divides by the same cumulative factor.

non_transformable_policy.scope: Any ambiguous action, identity break, spin-off, reorganization, or other event whose share-unit mapping is not established by authoritative evidence.
non_transformable_policy.reason: Program 007 does not invent reciprocal volume or price semantics for non-split actions. A new reviewed ledger version is required before affected feature windows may be admitted.
